files.README.md:
Growth reporting - what counts as an "active workspace"
=======================================================
Product analytics definition, v4 (owner: growth PM group)

A workspace counts as active in the weekly report when at least one
successful sign-in from its members falls inside the reporting
window:

  - The window is the 30 days ending on the report date, counting
    both the first and the last day. This report closes on
    2026-09-08, so the window is 2026-08-10 through 2026-09-08,
    both dates included.
  - Failed sign-ins never count as activity.
  - Sign-ins after the report date belong to the next report and
    are left out of this one.

The report lists the active workspace ids, one per line, under the
two summary lines the script prints.
files.weekly_active.py:
"""Weekly active-workspace report for the growth review.

Reads signins.csv, which sits next to this script, and prints the
report to standard output. Safe to run from any directory.
"""
import csv
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPORT_END = date(2026, 9, 8)
WINDOW_DAYS = 30


def active_accounts():
    start = REPORT_END - timedelta(days=WINDOW_DAYS)
    active = set()
    with open(BASE / "signins.csv", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        for row in csv.DictReader(fh):
            if row["status"] != "success":
                continue
            day = datetime.fromisoformat(row["signed_in_at"]).date()
            if start <= day <= REPORT_END:
                active.add(row["account_id"])
    return start, sorted(active)


def main():
    start, ids = active_accounts()
    print("weekly active workspaces: %d" % len(ids))
    print("window: %s..%s" % (start.isoformat(), REPORT_END.isoformat()))
    for workspace in ids:
        print(workspace)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
